text_block_list.text:
On the way home after finishing shopping 
on my day off—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san... Um, it is nothing of 
great importance, but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
My usual jogging route was blocked off due 
to construction today...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
After that, everywhere they went, they ran 
into construction work, road closures, and 
the like—

Pelted by the sudden rain, Silence Suzuka 
slumped her shoulders in defeat.
